_comment: What racers say at the diner and in the street. The game picks the pool by the moment and the racer, and one
line of it at random; some pools add up (pulled_up and pulled_up.aggressive for a hothead). stronger/weaker is
the racer's reputation against the player's (20 apart; 15 for pink slips), aggressive is aggression 70 and up
(bold: 60 and up). {car} is the player's car, or the car a grudge is about; {trackName} the track picked.
replies.* are the answers to a challenge the player puts to a racer; replies.snub what a diner's regulars say to a car
below the place's class (see diners); replies.boss.* a boss's, replies.rematch one
out for a rematch, replies.always_accept the answer when the testing switch makes everybody accept ({name} is the racer).

talk.greeting.stronger.aggressive: You got some nerve walking up to me.
Beat it, kid. I don't race amateurs.
You sure you're in the right place?
I've scraped better competition off my tires.
This ain't a kiddie ride, pal.
talk.greeting.stronger: You sure you want to do this?
I've got a reputation to maintain, you know.
Don't waste my time unless you're serious.
Look, I respect the hustle, but you're outmatched.
Maybe come back when you've got some wins under your belt.
talk.greeting.weaker.aggressive: Yeah, I know who you are. So what?
I've got nothing to lose and everything to prove.
Everyone's gotta fall sometime. Today's your day.
Don't let my record fool you. I'm ready.
talk.greeting.weaker: I've been waiting for a shot like this.
I'm faster than my record shows.
This could be my big break.
talk.greeting.even.aggressive: I've heard about you. Let's see what you've got.
You and me, we're cut from the same cloth.
I've been looking for a challenge.
talk.greeting.even: This should be a good race.
You look like you know what you're doing.
I respect your skills. Let's race.
Two evenly matched racers. I like it.
talk.pulled_up.boss: Heard you've been making noise. Pink slips. Right now.
You wanted a shot at me? Here I am. Your car against mine.
Nobody sits on my street without paying. Pink slips.
talk.pulled_up.pink_slip: Nice {car}. Be a shame to lose it. Pinks?
Winner drives home in both. You in?
I like that {car}. I'll like it more in my garage.
talk.pulled_up: You gonna sit there all night, or you wanna run?
Light's about to change. Let's see what you've got.
Hey! You racing, or just parked?
That {car} as quick as it looks?
talk.pulled_up.aggressive: I'll blow your doors off. Put your money where your mouth is.
Pull up to the line if you've got the guts.
talk.grudge: You and me aren't done. Pink slips, whenever you're ready.
I've been waiting for you. Rematch. Pink slips.
You got lucky last time. Let's go again, for the pinks.
talk.grudge.has_car: That's my {car} you're driving around. I want it back.
Enjoying my {car}? Put its pink slip on the table and we'll see how long you keep it.
talk.grudge.lost_car: You took my {car}. I'll take whatever you're driving now.
talk.grudge.aggressive: Everybody at this diner knows what you did. Race me.
talk.rematch: Now we're talking. I've been waiting for this.
Pink slips. Just like last time, except this time I win.
That's what I wanted to hear.
talk.rematch.has_car: Say goodbye to my {car}. It's coming home.
talk.track.aggressive: That's my kind of track. You're gonna regret this.
Good pick. I'll enjoy beating you there.
I know every inch of that strip.
You just made this easier for me.
talk.track: {trackName}, huh? I can work with that.
I've had some good runs there.
Solid pick. Should be a good race.
talk.pink_slip.stronger: Pink slips? Ha! I'll take that ride off your hands.
You're betting your car? This is gonna be fun.
Bold move. I respect that. Stupid, but respectable.
Your car's gonna look great in my garage.
Finally someone with guts. Let's do this.
talk.pink_slip.weaker.bold: Pink slips? You're on! I ain't scared!
If you're willing to lose your car, who am I to stop you?
High stakes? That's how I like it!
You want my car? Come and take it!
This is my chance to upgrade. Let's go!
talk.pink_slip.weaker: Pink slips... you sure about this?
That's a big bet. But okay, I'm in.
I hope you know what you're doing...
Alright, but don't say I didn't warn you.
talk.pink_slip.even: Pink slips it is. Winner takes all.
Now we're talking! High stakes racing!
You've got guts. I like that.
This is what real street racing is about.
May the best car win... literally.
talk.accepted.aggressive: You're on! Don't chicken out now!
See you at the line. Try not to embarrass yourself.
Let's settle this on the strip!
Time to put up or shut up!
talk.accepted: You're on. Good luck out there.
See you at the starting line.
talk.rejected.stronger: Not worth my time. Come back when you're somebody.
Maybe if you had something worth betting...
Pass. I've got better things to do.
You're not in my league, kid.
talk.rejected: Not today. The terms aren't right.
That's not a fair bet. Try again.
replies.accept.aggressive: You're on! Let's see what you got!
replies.accept.calm: Fair enough. See you at the track.
replies.accept: Alright, let's settle this on the track.
Deal. May the best racer win.
replies.no_pink_slips: Pink slips? That's too much for me. Not tonight.
I'm not risking my ride. Lower the stakes.
My car means too much to me. Cash only.
That's a bet I can't afford to lose. Pass.
replies.your_car_is_worth_less: Pink slips? Your bucket of bolts isn't worth my ride.
I'm not risking my car for that heap. Bring something better.
Come back with a car that's actually worth something.
That's not a fair trade. My car's worth way more than yours.
replies.your_car_is_worth_more: Your car's too nice. I can't match that stake.
That's out of my league. Find someone with a better ride.
I'd love to, but my car isn't worth that much.
replies.no_money: That's more than I've got on me. Lower the stakes.
I don't have that kind of cash. Make it smaller.
I'm not that flush right now. Can't cover that bet.
That's too rich for my blood. I don't have it.
replies.bet_too_high: That's way too steep for me. Not worth the risk.
Lower the bet and maybe we can talk.
That's not a bet, that's my rent money. No thanks.
I'm not gambling that much. Make it reasonable.
replies.reputation_too_low: Come back when you've proven yourself, rookie.
I don't race amateurs. Win a few more races first.
Beat some other racers before challenging me.
You need more street cred before I'll race you.
replies.snub: Not with that. Come back when you've got some real iron under the hood.
This ain't your diner, pal. Go find the folks who run what you run.
I don't race grocery-getters. Bring a car next time.
You're in the wrong place with that thing. Nothing personal.
Build something first. Then we'll talk.
replies.decline: Not feeling it tonight. Maybe another time.
I'm gonna pass on this one. Ask me later.
Nah, I'm not in the mood right now.
Maybe later. I need a break.
replies.car_laid_up: My car's laid up. Come back when it's running.
replies.car_unknown: I need to check my car first. Try again later.
replies.boss.pink_slips: Pink slips it is. Hope you said goodbye to that car.
replies.boss.no_pink_slip: I don't race for pocket money. Put your pink slip on the table, or go home.
